quick-test_capacity_mode_skips_ramping_a: Capacity mode skips ramping and measures each step independently.
quick-test_ramping_uses_10_linear_steps_: Ramping uses 10 linear steps. Steady-state metrics exclude warmup and ramp traffic.

quick-test_requests_are_scheduled_indepe: Requests are scheduled independently at constant intervals for the target RPS. Reaching the in-flight limit records local rejections.
quick-test_fixed_concurrency_starts_a_re: Fixed concurrency starts a replacement when a request completes to maintain the configured in-flight count.

quick-test_filter_steady_state_requests_: Filter steady-state requests by failure reason and inspect redacted, size-limited response details.
quick-test_primary_metrics_cover_steady_: Primary metrics cover steady state only. Warmup and ramp traffic are summarized separately.
quick-test_the_ramp_window_did_not_compl: The ramp window did not complete. Consider the request cap or early stop when interpreting preparation data.
quick-test_the_current_phase_reached_its: The current phase reached its request cap.

quick-test_duration_must_be_an_integer_f: Duration must be an integer from 0 to 3,600 seconds.
quick-test_warmup_request_count_must_be_: Warmup request count must be an integer from 0 to 10,000.
quick-test_ramp_duration_must_be_an_inte: Ramp duration must be an integer from 0 to 3,600 seconds.
quick-test_time_slice_must_be_an_integer: Time slice must be an integer from 0 to 3,600 seconds.

quick-test_target_compliance_must_be_gre: Target compliance must be greater than 0 when a latency threshold is enabled.
quick-test_concurrency_must_be_an_intege: Concurrency must be an integer from 1 to 256.
quick-test_ramp_request_cap_must_be_an_i: Ramp request cap must be an integer from 1 to 10,000.
quick-test_target_send_rps_must_be_from_: Target send RPS must be from 0.01 to 100,000.
quick-test_maximum_in_flight_must_be_an_: Maximum in flight must be an integer from 1 to 2,000.
quick-test_request_timeout_must_be_an_in: Request timeout must be an integer from 1 to 600 seconds.
quick-test_approximate_input_tokens_must: Approximate input tokens must be an integer from 1 to 1,000,000.
quick-test_maximum_output_tokens_must_be: Maximum output tokens must be an integer from 1 to 65,536.
quick-test_input_token_standard_deviatio: Input token standard deviation must be an integer from 0 to 1,000,000.
Input token standard deviation cannot exceed the input mean.
quick-test_output_token_standard_deviati: Output token standard deviation must be an integer from 0 to 65,536.
Output token standard deviation cannot exceed the output mean.
quick-test_shared_prefix_tokens_must_be_: Shared prefix tokens must be an integer from 0 to 999,999.

quick-test_random_seed_must_be_an_intege: Random seed must be an integer from 1 to 4,294,967,295.
quick-test_configure_a_valid_slo_before_: Configure a valid SLO before enabling a capacity ladder.
quick-test_a_capacity_ladder_requires_a_: A capacity ladder requires a request count greater than 0.
quick-test_starting_concurrency_must_be_: Starting concurrency must be a positive integer no greater than final concurrency.
quick-test_concurrency_step_must_be_a_po: Concurrency step must be a positive integer.
quick-test_starting_rps_must_be_from_0_0: Starting RPS must be from 0.01 to final RPS.
quick-test_rps_step_must_be_a_finite_num: RPS step must be a finite number greater than 0.

quick-test_warmup_value_ramp_value_stead: Warmup {{value1}} + ramp {{value2}} + steady state {{value3}} = {{value4}}, exceeding the total request budget of 10,000.

quick-test_the_endpoint_must_not_contain: The endpoint must not contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.
